discourse.title: Have Faith in God, the Only True Friend
discourse.excerpt: Faith is like the two eyes to a man. Devoid of faith, man is blind. It is only when he has faith in himself, can he have faith in God. Therefore, one has to develop faith in God in the first instance. With faith in God, one can achieve success in all one's endeavours.
discourse.theme: Faith is like two eyes; without it, man is blind.

reflection: My faith wavers — where do I even begin? Closer than you think: with faith in yourself. Swami says self-faith comes first, and faith in God follows. One small promise kept to yourself today — waking on time, finishing one task — is the seed. Faith is not a feeling you wait for; it is a muscle you use.

video.title: 05 - Follow God In Total Faith | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | November 04, 2002

seva_nudge: Attempt one small thing you have been afraid of, trusting Swami with the outcome.
